Docblock L4-25 ported and expanded: the proactive new-deploy detection purpose, the /system/version poll-and-compare-against-boot-`app_version` mechanism, the NewVersionBanner reload affordance, the dedicated 'teslasync:version' channel kept OFF the central @/lib/broadcast bus, the SSR/render-phase no-side-effects safety, and the graceful-degradation-when-channel-unavailable guarantee are all preserved. Type/const surface preserved verbatim: SystemVersionResponse { app_version: string } (L27-29); POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000 with the `// 5 minutes` comment (L31); VERSION_CHANNEL = 'teslasync:version' (L32); VersionEnvelope { version: string } (L34-36); and the exported VersionWatcherState interface with bootVersion/latestVersion/newVersionAvailable plus their three doc comments (L38-45) — only the latestVersion doc's 'peer tab' wording is annotated 'peer instance' to match the native in-process analog; the `iff bootVersion && latestVersion && latestVersion !== bootVersion` contract is unchanged.

Browser-only seam readChannel() (L47-55) — BroadcastChannel is unavailable on React Native and there are no peer tabs / same-origin documents to coordinate across (single process). Contract rule 7: replaced with a native-safe InProcessVersionChannel that implements the exact subset of the BroadcastChannel surface the hook touches (postMessage / addEventListener('message') / removeEventListener('message') / close) and replicates the 'a channel never receives its own posted message' semantic by fanning out to every OTHER open same-name channel via the module-level openChannels Set. readChannel() returns this in-process channel or null when nativeVersionWatcherCapabilities.inProcessCoordinationAvailable is false — the native equivalent of the web `typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof BroadcastChannel === 'undefined'` guard and its try/catch null fallback. The genuinely-unavailable cross-tab/cross-process scope is documented on the exported nativeVersionWatcherCapabilities descriptor (broadcastChannelAvailable/crossTabCoordinationAvailable=false, inProcessCoordinationAvailable=true, versionChannelName, unavailableReason). The DOM `MessageEvent<VersionEnvelope>` is replaced by a local VersionMessageEvent { data: VersionEnvelope } type.

fetchVersion() L57-73 ported verbatim: request<SystemVersionResponse>('/system/version'), the resp && typeof resp.app_version === 'string' && length > 0 guard returning app_version else null, and the catch that swallows transient errors but emits one console.warn for ApiError with status >= 400 && < 500 ('[useVersionWatcher] /system/version returned', status, message).
